mentions.name: The Curiosity Times
mentions.description: A printed newspaper for kids delivered monthly, filled with puzzles, math, nature facts, science experiments, card games, and outdoor scavenger hunts, giving children hours of fun, educational, screen-free activity each month.
mentions.problem: Wanted something for kids to do for hours every month that is fun, educational, and most importantly, screen free.
